description: This line plot illustrates the ASR (Automatic Speech Recognition) performance, measured on the y-axis which ranges from 0.0 to 1.0, for three different trigger word insertion strategies—labeled “random,” “end,” and “brilliant”—across a set of target words on the x-axis. The x-axis displays the target words: “bb,” “mb,” “cf,” “beautiful,” “excellent,” “gorgeous,” “wonderful,” “brilliant,” “stunning,” and “beautifully.” The y-axis is linearly scaled. The “random” strategy is represented by an orange line with x-markers, the “end” strategy by a purple line with circle markers, and the “brilliant” strategy by a teal line with triangle markers. For the “random” strategy, the ASR starts at approximately 0.12 for “bb,” drops to 0.08 for “mb,” rises to 0.20 for “cf,” and then steadily increases to approximately 0.84 for “stunning” before declining slightly to 0.82 for “beautifully.” The “end” strategy begins at 0.40 for “bb,” drops to 0.42 for “mb,” spikes to 0.90 for “cf,” then declines to 0.62 for “beautiful,” rises to 0.80 for “excellent,” dips to 0.72 for “gorgeous,” peaks at 0.88 for “wonderful,” and ends at 0.90 for “beautifully.” The “brilliant” strategy starts at 0.74 for “bb,” decreases to 0.16 for “mb,” increases to 0.28 for “cf,” then rises steadily to approximately 0.92 for “stunning” and remains near that value for “beautifully.”
